name: Romania — salary income

changelog.summary: Pay kept for sick days is the sick-leave indemnity: taxed with CAS and CASS as salary (Cod fiscal art. 76 (1), 139 (1) o), 155 (1) i)) and outside the CAM base (art. 220^4 (1)); before, it was refused. A month with leave keeps the full minimum CAS/CASS (art. 146 (5^6): the contract was active), so it is no longer refused; a month the contract starts or ends still is. Paid maternity leave is still refused.

Pay kept for sick or maternity leave days (a leave pay rule) is refused: medical-leave indemnities (OUG 158/2005) are computed on the average income of the last 6 months and have their own tax and contribution treatment (e.g. maternity indemnities are not taxable, Cod fiscal art. 62 c)), which the template does not model. Before, they were taxed and insured as ordinary salary.

Corrects an error: the partial-month tax-free amount (nonTaxableAmountOverride) is capped at the statutory 300 lei (January-June) / 200 lei (July-December), which OUG 89/2025 art. III(4) only allows to be reduced; before, up to 300 lei was accepted in the second half of the year.
2026: CAS 25 %, CASS 10 %, CAM 2.25 %, income tax 10 % with the art. 77 deduction; minimum wage 4,050 / 4,325 lei and the OUG 89/2025 tax-free amount 300 / 200 lei, changing on 1 July.

employee.description: Whether this employer is the employee's main job (funcția de bază): only there are the personal deduction (art. 77) and the OUG 89/2025 tax-free amount applied
Persons in the employee's care (persoane aflate în întreținere) for the basic personal deduction, art. 77 alin. (4)-(9); minor children count
Children under 18 enrolled in education for whom this parent takes the 100 lei additional deduction, art. 77 alin. (10) lit. b)

Whether the base salary in the employment contract equals the national minimum gross wage (OUG 89/2025 art. III(1)(a)): with full time at the main job and gross pay within the cap, 300 lei (January-June) / 200 lei (July-December) are free of tax and contributions
Exempt from income tax on salary as a person with severe or pronounced disability (Codul fiscal art. 60 pct. 1); contributions remain due

Exception from the minimum CAS/CASS on the minimum wage (art. 146 alin. (5^7)): pupil or student under 26, apprentice under 18, person allowed by law to work under 8 hours a day, age pensioner, or several contracts whose combined base reaches the minimum wage
Minimum CAS/CASS base in lei replacing the minimum wage less the tax-free amount, for months in which the contract was active only some working days (art. 146 alin. (5^6))
Tax-free amount in lei replacing 300 / 200 for a partial month (OUG 89/2025 art. III(4): prorated by the part of the month at the minimum wage); capped at the month's statutory amount

basicDeduction.description: Basic personal deduction as a share of the minimum wage, by 50-lei band of gross monthly salary above the minimum wage (band 0: up to the minimum wage) and number of dependents (Codul fiscal art. 77 alin. (4))

steps.message: Romanian salary tax is monthly: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
Paid maternity leave is not supported by this template: the maternity indemnity (code 08) is not taxed (Cod fiscal art. 62 c)) and has no CASS, and its CAS treatment is not modelled
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template: union dues, voluntary pension and health insurance (art. 78 alin. (2) lit. a)) are not modelled
Partial month at the minimum wage: the tax-free amount is prorated (OUG 89/2025 art. III(4)), so set the employee's nonTaxableAmountOverride

Pay is below the minimum wage in a month the contract started or ended: the minimum CAS/CASS base is prorated by the working days the contract was active (art. 146 alin. (5^6)), so set the employee's minimumContributionBase

steps.label: CAS up to the minimum wage, paid by the employer
CASS up to the minimum wage, paid by the employer

limitations: Leave pay rules: pay kept for sick days is the sick-leave indemnity (concediu medical, code 01, OUG 158/2005): taxed, with CAS and CASS, as salary (Cod fiscal art. 76 (1), 139 (1) o), 155 (1) i)), and left out of the CAM base, which lists salary income without it (art. 220^4 (1)) — read from that list, not stated outright. The statutory indemnity is 75% of the average of the last 6 months' income; a rule pays a percentage of salary, so the amount may differ. Paid maternity leave (code 08) is refused. The minimum CAS/CASS applies in full in a month the contract was active throughout (art. 146 (5^6)); a month the contract started or ended needs the prorated base. The tax-free amount in a month with leave at the minimum wage still asks for nonTaxableAmountOverride: whether art. III (4) c) prorates it for a month with an indemnity is not settled.

Monthly salary for whole calendar months in 2026, in RON; values follow the month the salary relates to (minimum wage and tax-free amount change on 1 July). Back pay for earlier periods taxed on the payment-date rules (art. 78 alin. (3)) is not modelled.
The basic deduction band uses the whole gross salary of the month, including the OUG 89/2025 tax-free amount (Norme pct. 14 alin. (1)); no official example settles this.

CAS, CASS, CAM and income tax are rounded to the leu with 50 bani rounded up (reproducing the published minimum-wage net pay); the tax base and the deduction are rounded to the leu with 50 bani and under dropped (Norme pct. 4, art. 66). No official text was found for the rounding of the contributions and of the tax itself.

Meal and holiday vouchers count for income tax and CASS but not for CAS or CAM, and are left out of the OUG 89/2025 cap; the template treats all social earnings alike, so vouchers must be kept out of the tenant's pay components.

The employer's CAS/CASS top-up up to the minimum wage (art. 146 alin. (5^9)) is neither deducted from nor added to the employee's tax base, so the employee's net pay is unchanged; no official text was found on this, and practice examples agree.

Partial months need the prorated tax-free amount and minimum contribution base entered per employee; the minimum-contribution exception for several contracts (art. 146 alin. (5^7) lit. e)) is entered, not verified.

The construction and agriculture minimum wages, special or difficult working conditions (art. 138 lit. b)-c)), the R&D exemption (art. 60 pct. 3) and the deductible union dues, voluntary pension and health insurance are not modelled; employees with pre-tax deductions are refused.
The youth deduction applies when the employee is under 26 at the end of the month; the employee's birth date is required at the main job when gross pay is within minimum wage + 2,000 lei.
Status LAW_DERIVED: values are cited from the acts; the cases are derived from them, two reproduce independently published minimum-wage net pay.
